however: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with something already said
resilient: able to recover quickly from difficulties
leverage: to use something to maximum advantage
ambiguous: open to more than one interpretation
pragmatic: dealing with things sensibly and practically
acknowledge: accept or admit the existence or truth of something
profound: very great or intense; having deep insight
subtle: so delicate as to be difficult to notice or describe
notion: a conception of or belief about something
advocate: a person who publicly supports something
facilitate: make an action or process easier
dynamic: characterized by constant change or progress
insight: a deep understanding of a situation
outcome: the way a thing turns out; a result
assumption: a thing accepted as true without proof
dedicated: devoted to a task or purpose
